increment_paragraph: **RETURN-FAMILY-STAR-AFTER-UNRESOLVED-CAST** (USER DECISION 2026-11-23: "RETURN-FAMILY-STAR-AFTER-UNRESOLVED-CAST -> Let's get started."; gateway rule 74h, extending rule 74g; `QCore.ReturnFamilyStarCast`; [report](../../reports/return-family-star-cast/README.md)). An unresolved type name reaches family S of `legacy_return_family`: `volatile` is a rejecting qualifier and a pointer typedef is left unresolved, so `is_cast_group` did not resolve `(volatile long)` and `unary_position` read the `*` after it as a multiplication. `return (volatile long) *p;` through a null untracked `p` therefore made `p` no base of the read node, and the function was `Safe`; the same body with `(long) *p` is `Unknown` (`unknown_alias:p`). `operator_at` now keeps `is_cast_group`'s resolved cast, asks rule 74f's one detector `ampersand_runs::may_close_a_cast` about every other `)` (with rule 74f's declared objects), and calls a group it cannot rule out undecided. Family S then keeps what either reading raises: the `&` refusal fires when either reading takes an address, an untracked root's starred base is the union of both readings' bases, and a may-bind root is admitted only when `stars_before` counts exactly one `*` under both the operand and the cast reading (a member or subscript root: none under the cast reading). The cast reading alone would have turned `stars_before`'s refusal of `(T) *q` into an admitted dereference base; reading both keeps the refusal, and the typed return route decides it from Clang's AST as before. No test admits more than at the base. Fixtures pin `return (T) *p;` with `T` unresolved (untracked and may-bind), the resolved cast, `f(x) * n` and `(a) * b` with `a` declared, at unit level (bound to the Lean vectors) and end to end. The change fixtures fail at the base, and no pin moved. Opt-in `current --monkey-linked` over Fluent Bit 046accf6, each run on its own tree and binary: base 5cfca8170 and tip 9de28d1ec are both 1,172/2/3,622/8, with no status or leaf change, as predicted. Scoped gate at 9de28d1ec: all 8 steps exit 0 (9,989 Rust tests passed, 493 Lean audits, 807 Python tests). The pinned routes cannot run on this host; no move is predicted.

ledger.why: Discharged by RETURN-FAMILY-STAR-AFTER-UNRESOLVED-CAST (rule 74h). Reachability: an unresolved type name reaches family S (`(volatile long)`, a pointer typedef), and crates/qcore-c-gateway/tests/return_family_star_cast.rs pins `return (volatile long) *p;` through a null untracked `p`, which was `Safe` at the base and is `Unknown` (`unknown_alias:p`). crates/qcore-c-gateway/src/legacy_return_family.rs `operator_at` decides the `)` arm with `is_cast_group` where it resolves a type and otherwise with the shared `ampersand_runs::may_close_a_cast` (no second detector). An undecided group keeps both readings: the `&` refusal and the starred untracked base take the union, and `stars_before` must count one `*` under both readings for a starred may-bind root (none under the cast reading for a member or subscript root), so the cast reading never turns `stars_before`'s refusal into an admission. Both directions are assessed in report §2 and proved in `QCore.ReturnFamilyStarCast`. `return (T) *p;` (untracked and may-bind), the resolved cast, `f(x) * n` and `(a) * b` with `a` declared are pinned at unit level and end to end; the change fixtures fail at the base. The opt-in corpus measurement shows no move (report §5); the pinned system and slice routes need build/cycle19 inputs this host lacks and were not run.

ledger.title: Family S counts `*(long *)*q` as one dereference of a may-bind `q`
ledger.text: RETURN-FAMILY-STAR-AFTER-UNRESOLVED-CAST found (report §6, unit level, by a scratch probe at its tip; the base reads resolved casts the same way) that crates/qcore-c-gateway/src/legacy_return_family.rs `scalar_read` admits `* ( long * ) * q` with `q` may-bind as the root of one dereference (`bases: ["q"]`). `stars_before` with a finite `closing` stops at the `)` of the resolved cast group, so the outer `*`, which dereferences the converted value `*q`, is not counted. That is a second dereference, which the module header says refuses for a may-bind name, and rule 12h's cast transparency applies only where `closing` is `usize::MAX`. The direction is admitting. The same reading counts `sizeof ( long ) * q` as one dereference of `q`, but a conforming body cannot spell it with a pointer `q` (C11 6.5.5p2), and a declared scalar never reaches the may-bind test. DISCHARGE: make a resolved cast group transparent to a starred may-bind root's count (so `*(T *)*q` counts two and refuses) or show that no such return reaches family S end to end, without admitting `*(T *)q` (one dereference of the converted value, not of `q`'s pointee alone); pin `return *(long *)*q;` end to end and measure.
